sophia.k: Hey — customer hit a 400 + weird rerank scores after copy-pasting the Console cURL example. They say all scores are 0.0. Repro steps attached.

lena.docs: ahhh that sounds like the quoting issue we've seen. Can you paste their exact curl?

sophia.k: sure, customer pasted this from the console "Copy cURL" button on Windows cmd:```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \n -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" \n -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \n -d "{\"query\":\"best onboarding flow\", \"documents\":[\"doc1\",\"doc2\"]}"```

jamal.eng: looks like the console sample includes nested double quotes and the Windows cmd stripped them or cmd interpreted the inner quotes. That -d portion becomes a single string instead of JSON object. Server tries to parse and ends up ranking default/empty inputs => 0 scores.

lena.docs: the console textarea also auto-escapes when copying, adding backslashes. On Bash that's fine, on Windows cmd you need ^ escaping or use --data-binary @file.json. We probably shouldn't show the raw escaped string in the main quick-copy.

support-bot: Ticket #SR-8672 created for customer (severity: medium).

sophia.k: customer reports they tried the example exact copy-paste and got a 400: ```{\n  \"error\": \"invalid_request\",\n  \"message\": \"Failed to parse JSON body\"\n}``` then after adjusting quotes they get a 200 but scores all 0.0.

jamal.eng: scores=0.0 likely means the reranker received empty documents or query field. Could be Content-Type mismatch (curl on Windows sometimes sends text/plain). Can you ask them to run a raw file variant? Example we should recommend:```json
// save as payload.json
{
  "query": "best onboarding flow",
  "documents": ["doc1 content here", "doc2 content here"]
}
```
Then:```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data-binary @payload.json
```

lena.docs: let's patch docs to show both forms and a Windows-specific note. Also change the Console copy button to offer two flavors: "cURL (unix)" and "cURL (windows)" so we don't push the escaped string blindly.

docs-bot: PR opened: github.com/redwood/docs/pull/782 (includes Windows guidance and file-based example).

sophia.k: I've sent the file-based repro to the customer. Also added explicit step: run with --verbose to confirm Content-Type and body bytes.

jamal.eng: thanks — I'll add a server-side guard to return a clearer error when body is a string that parses to JSON-within-string (common from bad quoting). That should make support triage faster.

lena.docs: awesome. I'll also add a short troubleshooting note to the rerank console UI: "If results look like all-zero scores, confirm your request body is valid JSON (try @file.json or --data-binary)."

sophia.k: closing loop with customer once PR merged. Thanks team :thumbsup:
